title.note: Game title kept per glossary (brand); Vietnamese press and code guides keep English Roblox titles.

hud.cast.note: "Thả câu" is the everyday Vietnamese phrase for casting a fishing line; 7/8.

hud.reel.note: "Kéo" = pull the fish in, the fishing sense; same verb as the pass Kéo Tự Động. "Kéo cần" (7) is the longer option if testers find bare "Kéo" too terse.
hud.reel.review_reason: Bare "Kéo" does not say what is pulled and can read as the noun "scissors"; "Kéo cần" (7/8) names the reel-in action, pairs with "Thả câu" and keeps the Kéo verb of the pass Kéo Tự Động.

hud.bait_left.note: Vietnamese nouns never inflect, so "{count} mồi" is correct for 0, 1 and more, like the guide's "{count} xu".

hud.backpack.note: Dictionary spelling of backpack; Roblox's own UI writes "Balo".

catch.success.note: Order flipped: Vietnamese puts the modifier after the noun ("Cá Chép Vàng Hiếm"). No classifier or article, so any fish name fits; tier names are capitalized so they read as a tag.

catch.escaped.note: "tuột mất" = slipped off the hook; names the generic "cá" instead of "it", as context allows.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: vi-vn uses a comma for decimals and a period for thousands, so "12.4 kg" can read wrong; send "12,4" for this locale.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name, translated as glossary says: "cá chình" (eel) + "đèn lồng" (lantern), 17/18. "Lươn Đèn Lồng" is shorter and cuter, but "lươn" is teen slang for a sneaky person, a poor fit for the mascot.

rarity.mythic.note: Standard Vietnamese tier above Huyền Thoại (Legendary), as in Blox Fruits guides; 10/10.

shop.equipped.note: State label "in use", distinct from the button "Trang bị"; "Đã trang bị" (11/11) is the alternative.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide pattern: "bằng" = paying with; "Mua với" would be a calque.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel (Kéo), modifier after the noun; title case as a pass name. The Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Mồi May Mắn nhân đôi cơ hội câu được cá hiếm!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name built from Mồi (Bait) + may mắn (luck); "cá hiếm" matches the Rare tier Hiếm.

sell.done.text: Đã bán {count} con cá được {coins} xu!
sell.done.note: "con" is the classifier for fish; nouns never inflect, so count = 1 and coins = 1 both read correctly.

sell.prompt.note: Roblox's own pattern ("Nhấn {KEY_NAME} để..."). Source-side: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText "Bán" would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: "Thăng hạng" = rise a rank, fitting a prestige level; 10/10. Avoided "Phi thăng" (Taoist ascension, religious), "Tái sinh" (that is Rebirth) and "Thăng cấp" (too close to level-up). "Đột phá" (Genshin's word for Ascension) is the alternative.

ascend.confirm.text: Thăng hạng ngay? Bạn sẽ chơi lại từ đầu, nhưng tỉ lệ câu được cá hiếm tăng {bonus}%.
ascend.confirm.note: Same Ascend word as ascend.button. "chơi lại từ đầu" = start over; "thường xuyên hơn {bonus}%" = {bonus}% more often. Percent with no space, per the guide.
ascend.confirm.review_reason: "thường xuyên hơn {bonus}%" calques "more often"; Vietnamese puts a percent increase on the rate ("tỉ lệ ... tăng {bonus}%"), same meaning.

weather.storm.text: Bão sắp tới! Cá hiếm đang cắn câu.
weather.storm.note: "cắn câu" = take the bait, the fishing sense of biting.

quest.catch_n.text: Câu {n} con cá ở Vịnh Ánh Trăng
quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated per glossary as Vịnh Ánh Trăng; in-world signs and map labels should match. No plural, so n = 1 is fine.

friends.boost.text: Câu cá cùng bạn bè được +{percent}% may mắn
friends.boost.note: "được" = you get; keeps the + and writes the percent with no space. "bạn bè", not Roblox's "người quen".

trade.sent.text: Đã gửi lời mời giao dịch cho {player}
trade.sent.note: "lời mời giao dịch" (trade invitation) is how Vietnamese games word a trade request; gender-free.

trade.accept.text: {player} đã đồng ý giao dịch với bạn
trade.accept.note: "your trade" rendered as "giao dịch với bạn"; verbs never change for gender, so any {player} fits.

codes.enter.note: Players say "nhập code"; "Nhập mã" is the formal alternative.
codes.enter.blind_remark: uses the English loanword 'code' rather than Vietnamese 'ma'; casual gamer usage

codes.redeemed.text: Nhập code thành công! Tận hưởng phần quà nhé!
codes.redeemed.note: "Nhập code thành công" is the usual Vietnamese wording for a redeemed code, matching codes.enter; 45/45, at budget. "nhé" adds the friendly tone.
codes.redeemed.blind_remark: uses the English loanword 'code'; casual gamer usage

afk.kicked.text: Bạn AFK quá lâu nên đã dừng câu cá.
afk.kicked.note: "AFK" is how Vietnamese players say idle (the guide's own afk.warning uses it). "Bạn đứng yên quá lâu..." is the no-slang alternative. No removal from the server added.
afk.kicked.blind_remark: unclear who stopped it: reads as either 'you stopped fishing' or 'fishing was stopped'; says nothing about being removed from the game; keeps the English abbreviation 'AFK'

event.ends.note: 13/14. For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; "h" reads as giờ but "d" is not Vietnamese (ngày). Send "2 ngày 4 giờ" or a countdown like "2:04:00:00" for vi-vn.

daily.streak.text: Chuỗi {day} ngày! Ngày mai quay lại để nhận thêm quà nhé!
daily.streak.note: "Chuỗi {day} ngày" = a {day}-day streak; no plural, so day = 1 is fine. "for more" made explicit as more gifts (quà). "Điểm danh" (check-in) is a common alternative label.

tip.night.text: Mẹo: Có loài cá chỉ cắn câu vào ban đêm.

group.join.text: Tham gia cộng đồng của chúng mình để nhận 50 mồi miễn phí!
group.join.note: "cộng đồng" per Roblox's Groups -> Communities rename in its Vietnamese UI; "của chúng mình" (our) makes clear it is the studio's group. Near the 60 budget: drop "của chúng mình" if the banner is tight.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Biggest = heaviest by weight, so "nặng nhất"; sentence case per the guide.
